candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents optic disc neuritis/papillary edema progressing to optic atrophy (supporting optic neuritis), but also shows anterior uveitis, vitreous inflammation, retinal vasculitis, and peripapillary hemorrhages consistent with panuveitis, all in the context of confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection. 'Right Optic Neuritis' captures only one component of the composite diagnosis and omits the broader uveitic syndrome and its etiology.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Optic neuritis is a component of the full diagnosis but omits the panuveitis (anterior chamber inflammation, vitreous inflammation, retinal vasculitis) and the SARS-CoV-2 etiology

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis uses non-standard terminology ('inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy') rather than conventional 'optic neuritis'; the optic nerve involvement is well-supported by RAPD, central scotoma, papillary edema progressing to atrophy, and FA leakage
